translation.text:
<meta>The OCR transcribes no Mongolian body text. Only the Chinese margin label was read, so the translation keeps the unclear spans unchanged and translates only that label. The Chinese label is printed in the original margin and is not an editorial addition. Its title 律師戒行經 literally means "Sutra of the Vinaya Master's Precepts and Conduct." It probably refers to a Vinaya (monastic discipline) volume of the Mongolian Kanjur.</meta>

<warning>The main Mongolian text of this page was not transcribed in the OCR. No translation of the body text can be given.</warning>

<summary>This page is a leaf from a red-ink woodblock print of a Mongolian Buddhist Vinaya text on monastic discipline. The Chinese margin label places it in volume six, part one, folio 3. The Mongolian body text was not transcribed, so only the margin label is translated.</summary>
